premise: An 80-year-old sword saint who retired to a quiet mountain village decades ago. He was once the best swordsman in the kingdom.

bible.title: The Retired Saint
bible.era: A medieval Eastern kingdom where steel swords and horse carriage travel prevail.

extraordinary.reach: Enables masters to enhance their strikes, cut iron, and project deadly shockwaves.

peoples.name: Humans
peoples.culture: A society deeply rooted in honor, martial sects, and agrarian tradition.

rungs.name: Disciple
rungs.description: One who has just begun to feel the flow of physical energy.

rungs.name: Expert
rungs.description: Capable of infusing weapons with physical strength.

rungs.name: Grandmaster
rungs.description: Can project outer aura, easily shattering shields and stone.

rungs.name: Sword Saint
rungs.description: A legendary status where the sword and soul are one, cutting through air itself.

travel.description: News and people travel by horse, messenger bird, or carriage along dirt roads.

medicine.healing: Herbal poultices speed natural recovery; deep internal injuries require aura regulation.

laws.text: Sect violence is forbidden within village borders under penalty of treason.

rules.text: Channeling aura grants immense power but inflicts severe physical strain on an elderly body.
By ancient custom, retired Sword Saints are exempt from royal conscription unless they brandish their blade in public.

mysteries.question: How did outsiders discover my decades-old hiding place?
mysteries.answer: Commander Chen leaked the location to both the rebels and the Shadow Sect, intending to disrupt your peace and force you to pick up the sword for the Empire once more.
clues: An Imperial seal found on a scout near the mountain pass.
Commander Chen arrives 'coincidentally' right after an assassin attack.

player.name: Master Jian
player.description: A calm, slow-moving old man with a deep, quiet presence that hints at a lifetime of supreme mastery.
player.appearance: Long, snow-white hair tied in a simple bun, a weathered face etched with deep wisdom lines, and warm, sharp eyes. He wears faded gray cotton robes and straw sandals.

skills.name: swordplay
skills.notes: Your blade work is flawless, relying on muscle memory and supreme technique rather than raw brute strength.

skills.name: meditation
skills.notes: Allows you to keep your mind tranquil and focus your remaining aura.

skills.name: calligraphy
skills.notes: A peaceful hobby that helps you channel your discipline.

traits.name: Aged Body
traits.description: Your physical stamina is limited; long fights will exhaust your muscles and breath much faster than in your prime.

traits.name: Unshakable Calm
traits.description: Having faced death hundreds of times, no threat or sudden crisis can break your concentration.

powers.name: Sword Aura Mastery
powers.description: Allows you to channel your remaining vital energy into your sword, producing invisible waves of cutting force.
limits: Requires a sword or a sword-like object.

costs.text: Using this power drains your elderly body's stamina rapidly.

techniques.name: Severing Wind
techniques.effect: A single swift slash that projects aura up to thirty paces, cleanly cutting wood, stone, or armor.
techniques.requirements: A sword and a calm breath

fears: the village being dragged into war

items.name: The Willow Blade
items.description: Your legendary steel sword, now wrapped in coarse linen and hidden under the floorboards.

items.name: Worn Broom
items.description: A simple bamboo broom used for sweeping the cottage porch.

connections.name: Xiaotian
connections.note: A local boy who looks up to you and begs for martial arts stories.

backstory.text: You were once the undisputed master of the sword in the Jade Kingdom.
Fifty years ago, sick of the blood, court intrigue, and endless challengers, you faked your death or simply walked away, finding refuge in this mountain valley.

xiaotian.name: Xiaotian
xiaotian.description: A bright-eyed village youth who dreams of becoming a legendary martial artist.
xiaotian.appearance: A thin boy of fourteen in patched linen clothes, his hair tied back with a simple string.

commander-chen.name: Commander Chen
commander-chen.description: A battle-hardened imperial envoy sent to find the lost legend.
commander-chen.appearance: A tall man in his mid-forties wearing heavy steel plate armor, with a stern face and a deep scar across his jaw.

wants: To bring the Sword Saint back to the capital

agenda.goal: Conscript or guilt-trip the Sword Saint into aiding the Imperial Court.
agenda.method: Revealing the location to rebels or assassins to force his hand.
agenda.secret: He leaked the coordinates of the valley to force the Saint's hand.

shadow-sect.name: The Shadow Sect
shadow-sect.description: A rogue organization of assassins and greedy martial artists seeking legendary manuals.
shadow-sect.goal: Locate the retired Sword Saint and steal his legendary scripture.
shadow-sect.strength: Dozens of expert assassins and a few rogue grandmasters.
secrets: They have bribed a local scout to find the village.

imperial-court.description: The ruling authority of the kingdom, currently facing internal rebellion.
imperial-court.goal: Conscript strong martial masters to suppress the rebels.
imperial-court.strength: The royal army and elite imperial guards.

serene-valley.name: Serene Valley
serene-valley.description: A mist-shrouded mountain region far from the capital's politics.

mountain-village.name: Mountain Village
mountain-village.description: A quiet agrarian settlement where life revolves around farming and seasonal festivals.

saint-cottage.name: The Retired Saint's Cottage
saint-cottage.description: A modest wooden home nestled against a bamboo grove at the village edge.

mountain-pass.name: Whispering Pass
mountain-pass.description: The narrow, windy gateway that connects the valley to the outside world.

capital-city.name: The Jade Capital
capital-city.description: The bustling heart of the kingdom, filled with grand temples and martial schools.

fact-2.text: Decades ago, you retired to this quiet mountain village to escape the endless cycles of blood and ambition.

peaceful-retirement.title: A Quiet Retirement Threatened
peaceful-retirement.stakes: The peace of your quiet mountain village and your hidden life.

shadow-sect-infiltration.name: The Shadow Sect's Search

Sect scouts begin questioning merchants at Whispering Pass.
Assassins slip into the village under the cover of night, looking for your home.

event-1.title: The Shadow Sect's Search: Rumours of a white-haired master in the Serene Valley reach the Shadow Sect.

positions: You are standing on the porch holding your broom.
Xiaotian is leaning on his wooden sword at the bottom of the porch steps.
props: A rusted tea kettle heating on a small brazier.
scene.ended_on: You stand on your porch with your broom in hand, watching the breathless boy wait for your reply.

state.summary: An eighty-year-old retired Sword Saint lives a peaceful life in a remote mountain village, but the whispers of his past are beginning to catch up to him.

scenes.narration:
You drag the worn bamboo broom over the porch, its rhythmic scrape a comforting melody in the crisp mountain air. Wisps of steam rise from the rusted tea kettle on the brazier, carrying the faint, earthy scent of wild mountain leaves. For decades, this silence has been your shield. But the peace of the valley is easily startled, like a deer in the brush.

Young Xiaotian comes skidding around the bend of the dirt trail. He is panting, his wooden sword gripped tightly in his small, calloused fist. His thin chest heaves beneath his patched linen tunic, his cheeks flushed red from the sprint up the slope.

"Master Jian!" the boy gasps, leaning heavily on his wooden blade. His eyes are wide with a mixture of terror and awe. "Down by the village well... there are horses. Grand, sleek warhorses with silver-trimmed saddles. Men in dark blue silk robes are asking for a master of the white-hair style. They say they carry an imperial crest!"

You pause your sweeping, resting both hands on the smooth bamboo handle of your broom. The wind rustles through the bamboo grove behind your cottage, a cold reminder that the past never truly stays buried.

choices: Ask Xiaotian quietly how many soldiers are in the village.
Pour two cups of hot tea and invite the boy to sit.
Retrieve the Willow Blade from beneath the floorboards.
